title: eludite/project/itemProperties
description: Brief 0081: Visual Studio's File Properties for one file of a project (the Properties window, F4): its item type (Build Action), Copy to Output Directory, Custom Tool and Custom Tool Namespace, from the project's evaluation (SDK default items included). A file the project does not list answers with itemType None and listed false.

generation.description: The generation the shell read the tree under. Not the current generation: -32801 (ContentModified), nothing written.

project.description: Absolute path of the project file.

listed.description: The evaluation lists the file as an item.

itemType.description: The MSBuild item type (Compile, Content, None, EmbeddedResource, AdditionalFiles, Page, ...); None when not listed.

itemTypes.description: The Build Action choices for this project, Visual Studio's list (the project's own item types added).

copyToOutputDirectory.description: never (Do not copy), always (Copy always), preserveNewest (Copy if newer).

implicit.description: The item comes from the SDK's default globs (no element of the project file includes it by name): an edit writes an Update item.

line.description: 1-based line of the element that includes the file, when it is in the project file.
